supportedPaths.name: tippecanoe-direct-pmtiles
supportedPaths.description: Use tippecanoe to build PMTiles directly from newline-delimited GeoJSON or GeoJSON sources.

supportedPaths.name: pmtiles-cli-convert
supportedPaths.description: Use a PMTiles CLI to convert a compatible MBTiles/vector-tile archive into a .pmtiles file.

notes: No PMTiles archive is generated unless a supported CLI is installed or TEST_PMTILES_CLI/TEST_TIPPECANOE points to one.
The /test runtime can load pmtiles sourceType entries through the pmtiles protocol once archives are generated and registered in maps-test.json.
GDAL directory MVT remains the active local conversion path in this Windows environment.
